issues.description: Theme is 'a surprise birthday party', but nothing in the dialogue or glosses establishes a surprise; the title promises 'A Surprise Birthday Cake' while the clip only shows Ben baking a cake. The surprise is at best implied (Anna didn't know he was baking).
issues.suggested_fix: Add a small cue of surprise, e.g. Anna's line 3: 'Oh, that's nice! It's a surprise for Mum!' or adjust the visual cue/stage direction so the surprise element is explicit.

issues.description: The grammar note is accurate but incomplete: it does not state that the 'when' clause takes the past simple (the shorter interrupting action), which is the pattern the dialogue itself models ('when I called').
issues.suggested_fix: Extend the note: '...another action in the past. We use the past simple after "when" for the shorter action: I was baking when you called.'

issues.description: Estimated clip length is about 8-9 seconds (three short lines plus 1.4s of pauses), slightly under the spec's 0.17 min (about 10.2s) minimum.
issues.suggested_fix: Add one short line (e.g. Anna: 'Can I help?') or a slightly longer pause to bring the clip within the 10-15 second window.

qa_report.summary: A clean, accurate micro-dialogue. Both lines model the target structure (past continuous with 'when') correctly and naturally, all vocabulary is at or below A2, and the three glosses are simple, accurate and easier than the words they explain. No grammar, collocation or gloss errors. Minor points only: the 'surprise' element of the theme is not explicit in the clip, the grammar note could add that 'when' takes the past simple, and the clip may run a second or two under the 10-second minimum. None of these blocks approval.
